description: Read-only OpenAI Codex usage-limit reset data: 24/48h reset forecast, verified reset record with sources, and Codex service status. Hosted, no API key.
name: Codex Reset

tools.name: get_reset_forecast
tools.title: Codex reset forecast
tools.description: Current probability that OpenAI resets Codex usage limits in the next 24 and 48 hours, with confidence, the last confirmed reset time and any active official signal. A forecast, not a promise.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable copy. Default en.

tools.title: Codex reset record
tools.description: Dated record of verified Codex usage-limit resets and related announcements (boosts, unlocks, credits), newest first, each with its source URL.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable copy. Default en.

tools.name: get_codex_status
tools.title: Codex service status
tools.description: Current OpenAI Codex service state as tracked by codex-reset.com, to tell an outage apart from a usage limit.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable copy. Default en.
